messages.author: fa51e47cdd090afc
messages.subject: Recalibration of datasets
parts:
Hi all,
is there any way to perform a recalibration of a dataset from other file?
For example, you scan 3 or 4 tissues from an experiment and then, in the same slide you have a "spot" with a mix of calibrants. 
How can someone recalibrate the dataset generated using only this "calibrant" spot?
I'm currently using other aproximation, spraying the calibrants together with the matrix, but i think that maybe this way could be easiest one to get the data correctly adjusted.
Thanks in advance!

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Recalibration of datasets
parts:
There is currently no automated way to do this in Cardinal, but I would be interested in adding it. However, I am not sure of the best way to go about it, since I have not worked with any example datasets that do this. If you know of any papers or references (especially if there is example data) that have investigated the best ways to do this for imaging, please send them to me, and I will take a look.

-Ky
